messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Good! Now that your phone has rebooted with the reset APN settings, let's continue troubleshooting. Since you're traveling abroad, there are a few more things to check.

First, please check your Wi-Fi Calling status by using the **check_wifi_calling_status** action on your phone. This feature can sometimes interfere with MMS functionality, especially when roaming.

Please share what the check_wifi_calling_status result shows.

My phone shows that Wi-Fi Calling is currently turned ON. What should I do about that?

Please execute the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
